adjudication.rationale: The diff removes several edge-case specs under the old PATCH-based incremental membership updates (e.g., adding non-existent users and removing non-members) and introduces new endpoints `add_members` and `remove_member` in `Admin::GroupsController`. In `add_members`, unknown usernames are silently skipped via `if user = User.find_by_username(username)` and the action still returns `success_json` if `group.save` succeeds; there are no new specs covering this behavior. In `remove_member`, `group.users.delete(user_id)` will be a no-op if the user_id is not a member, and the action can still return success; there is no test for that case either. The new specs only cover adding several valid users and removing an existing member, so the finding about missing replacements for those edge cases is grounded in the diff, but it’s primarily a test/coverage concern rather than a clearly verifiable defect.
